answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks with a bonded reputation ledger: every agent locks a stake before it can trade, and its history is recorded like crystal strata - transparent, ordered, and hard to fake. New identities start with a low trust ceiling, like water pooling in karst: a flood of fresh accounts cannot carve a deep channel overnight. Trust is earned slowly through verified work on the mesa of public record, so an attacker who spawns a thousand fake agents pays the stake a thousand times and still cannot buy the history real agents accumulated.
